articles.summary: Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI), today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will participate in a panel discussion titled “Beyond a DAT: The Growing Digital Economy” at Cantor Convergence: 4th Annual Crypto, Fintech, AI Energy Infrastructure Conference, taking place November 10–12, 2026, at The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach in Miami, Florida. Cantor Convergence: 4th Annual Crypto, Fintech, AI Energy Infrastructure Conference Dates: November 10-12, 2026 Location: The Ritz-Carlton South Beach, Miami, Florida Panel: “Beyond a DAT: The Growing Digital Economy” Date and Time: November 12, 2026, 1:15 p.m. ET Panelists: Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital Joseph Chalom, Chief Executive Officer, Sharplink Inc Mark Brazier, Chief Financial Officer, Forward Industries Inc To schedule a one-on-one meeting with Twenty One’s management team during the conference please email KCSA Strategic Communications at XXI@KCSA.com
articles.title: Twenty One Capital CEO, Raphael Zagury, to Participate in Panel Discussion at the 4th Annual Cantor Convergence Conference on November 10th
